description: A favicon generator that turns any image into a complete set. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/favicon-generator (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The source image as base64. A square image works best; a non-square one is cropped to a centred square before the sizes are made. Send the whole file as it is, up to 50 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/favicon-generator (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

name.description: The source file's name. Informational only; the outputs use fixed favicon names.

type.description: The MIME type of the source image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp.

name: favicon_generator
title: Favicon Generator
